examples.title: Leading slots
examples.description: The leading slot holds an icon, an avatar, a 56px thumbnail or a control, each sized for its kind.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Avatar, GroupedList, GroupedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<GroupedList header="People">
  <GroupedListItem href="/people/ada">
    {#snippet leading()}<Avatar name="Ada Lovelace" />{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Ada Lovelace{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Engineer{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem href="/people/grace">
    {#snippet leading()}<Avatar name="Grace Hopper" />{/snippet}
    {#snippet title()}Grace Hopper{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Admiral{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
</GroupedList>

examples.title: Text actions
examples.description: Rows whose button is their point end in secondary small buttons. On a phone the buttons drop under the text at their own width instead of folding into a menu, and a status leads the subtitle as a dot and its word.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { GroupedList, GroupedListItem, StatusDot } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<GroupedList aria-label="Waiting on you">
  <GroupedListItem actions={[{ label: 'Answer', href: '/reviews/1', changes: true }]}>
    {#snippet title()}Which environment should the release go to?{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Question, Request human input, waiting 3 h{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem actions={[{ label: 'View run', href: '/runs/7' }]}>
    {#snippet title()}Nightly backup{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}<StatusDot word="Running" />, Schedule, started 10:42 AM{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
</GroupedList>

examples.title: Time-led rows
examples.description: A fixed 72px lead holds a number and a unit from a closed vocabulary. Urgent uses the warning text colour, soon is muted, and a stale row draws a gray clock and a short age.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { GroupedList, GroupedListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<GroupedList header="Open now">
  <GroupedListItem href="/places/rooftop" leadValue={45} leadUnit="min left" urgency="urgent">
    {#snippet title()}The Rooftop{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Half-price wells until 8:00 pm{/snippet}
    {#snippet trailing()}0.4 mi{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem href="/places/lantern" leadValue="4:30" leadUnit="starts" urgency="soon">
    {#snippet title()}Lantern Room, which has a much longer name that wraps onto a second line{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Two-dollar drafts{/snippet}
    {#snippet trailing()}1.2 mi{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
  <GroupedListItem href="/places/pier" leadValue="Fri" staleAge="3d">
    {#snippet title()}The Pier{/snippet}
    {#snippet subtitle()}Oysters and rosé{/snippet}
    {#snippet trailing()}2.8 mi{/snippet}
  </GroupedListItem>
</GroupedList>
